findings.finding: CMR substudy enrolled 69 (31 aficamten, 38 placebo); 61 had both baseline and week-36 scans (25 and 36).
findings.limitation: Small selected subset; six versus two lack paired scans by subtraction. Missingness reasons, analysis assumptions and full-study representativeness require independent review.

findings.location: PDF page 6; rendered graph and text inspected
findings.finding: Reported week-36 LVMI effect −5.0 g/m² (95% CI −8.2 to −1.8; P=.003) and wall thickness −2.3 mm (−3.0 to −1.5; P<.001).
findings.limitation: Substudy imaging effects are surrogate/structural findings; no independent clinical-outcome or multiplicity verdict.

findings.finding: Reported no significant changes in LAVI, late-gadolinium enhancement, native T1 or extracellular-volume measures.
findings.limitation: Nonsignificance is not evidence of no effect; sample and precision limit inference.

findings.location: PDF pages 7 and 11; rendered methods/table inspected
findings.finding: Secondary health-status analysis uses KCCQ-OSS, reporting week-36 difference +4.0 points (95% CI 1.6–6.5; P=.001).
findings.limitation: Do not replace pivotal KCCQ-CSS +3.0 with KCCQ-OSS +4.0; distinct endpoint and estimand.

findings.finding: MMRM includes treatment, visit, interaction, strata and baseline. Inclusion requires baseline plus at least one follow-up KCCQ (98.7%); secondary comparisons are unadjusted for multiplicity.
findings.limitation: These secondary-analysis methods do not authenticate the final locked pivotal SAP or prove complete intention-to-treat follow-up.

findings.finding: Responder thresholds are drawn from heart-failure and obstructive-HCM populations and are not directly established in nonobstructive HCM.
findings.limitation: Categorical responder/NNT claims require nHCM threshold validity, interval, missingness and multiplicity review.

findings.finding: Week-36 total-symptom difference +1.9 (95% CI −0.5–4.4; P=.12); SAQ-SS +2.5 (−0.1–5.0; P=.059).
findings.limitation: Later variable-time EOT results do not replace the nonsignificant week-36 comparisons; later cohorts shrink by design.

findings.location: FDA snapshot study design and labeled indication; original FDA label section 1
findings.finding: FDA approval record describes SEQUOIA-HCM NCT05186818, 282 patients with obstructive HCM; label concerns NDA219083 original indication.
findings.limitation: Neither this approval nor its outcome/denominator may be transferred to ACACIA nHCM. Label heart-failure/REMS risk is regulatory context only.

findings.location: Official trial record identity and administrative-act fields
findings.finding: INVIMA record matches NCT06081894 and links CY6033, with national clinical-trial administrative act dated March 14, 2025.
findings.limitation: Trial authorization is not marketing authorization or FDA approval, and does not independently verify global phase completion.
